Hi Marcus / Priyom,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement and legal have a few gating items before we can move the PO forward:

- Confirmation that customer data for MedSecure (EU patients) will be processed and persist only within the EU (data residency).
- Proof we can provide a private connectivity option (VPC peering or Private Connector) so PHI does not traverse public internet.
- Standard evidence set: latest SOC 2 report (redacted ok), SIG questionnaire or CAIQ, and your standard DPA + SCCs.
- Any HIPAA-specific controls or attestations you can provide for healthcare workloads.

Attached is our short RFI to capture specifics. Can you confirm what you can commit to contractually and estimate a timeline for a private deployment or VPC setup? Procurement is targeting a signed agreement by end of May if these items are green.

Thanks,
Lena Fischer
Senior Procurement Manager

Hi Lena — really appreciate the clear list. Short answers up front:

- Yes — we can support EU-only processing and persistence (you can pin environments to eu-west-1 / eu-central-1).
- Private connectivity: we offer Private Connector (VPC peering / AWS PrivateLink equivalent) for Private deployments and can scope a Dedicated capacity option if you need isolated GPU pools.
- Evidence: we can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II, a completed SIG partial response, our CAIQ export, and our standard DPA + SCCs.
- HIPAA: we operate under our security controls and can provide control mappings and a HIPAA-attestation matrix for PHI handling.

I attached a short overview of the EU residency and connectivity options to this thread and propose a 30-minute technical sync with your infrastructure lead to validate network requirements and a mutual action plan. Suggested times: Fri 11th 09:00-11:00 or Mon 14th 14:00-16:00 CEST.

Next steps I propose:
1) Tech sync to confirm VPC architecture and KMS requirements.
2) Legal review of our DPA + SCCs and provide a redlined copy if needed.
3) Pilot window for Private deployment (4-6 weeks typical for pilot, dependent on networking).

If that works I’ll loop in Compliance for the SOC/SIG artifacts and have Legal prepare DPA steps.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood-eu-residency-overview.pdf (pdf))

Marcus / Priyom — see summary below and attached artifacts. I’ve cc'd LegalOps for DPA redlines but putting the compliance items here: 

1) Contractual commitments
- We can contractually commit to EU-only processing for a named environment and to not replicate customer data outside the EU. Our standard DPA includes an option to specify geographic processing boundaries; we will provide SCCs as part of the DPA package.

2) Evidence pack & timeline
- Available for immediate delivery: redacted SOC 2 Type II summary (high-level report), SOC2 control matrix export (summary), CAIQ export, and a completed SIG Lite/partial response. Attachments included: SOC2-summary.pdf, signed-sccs-template.docx.
- ETA: we can assemble the redacted SOC2 and SIG export within 3 business days. Full SOC2 confidential report is provided under NDA; redacted version should suffice for procurement screening.

3) Network & infra (Priyom to confirm ops steps)
- Private Connector approach: we can provision a Private deployment in an EU region and enable Private Connector (VPC peering / PrivateLink). Customer manages their VPC endpoint; we provide peering details and a network handbook.
- KMS: support for Customer-managed keys (BYOK) via partner KMS is available in Private deployments; note that on the Hosted (shared) tier we expose application-level encryption but not customer-managed encryption keys.
- Pilot estimate: assuming procurement provides peering ACLs promptly, pilot readiness 3–5 weeks; Dedicated reserved capacity roll-out 6–8 weeks depending on GPU provisioning windows.

4) HIPAA/PHI
- We treat PHI as high sensitivity. While we are not a HIPAA-covered entity, our controls and HIPAA-mapping document are sufficient for most business associate (BAA) assessments. If MedSecure requires a BAA, Legal can evaluate and execute standard language — we'd need legal procurement contact details and internal approvals.

Next actions I recommend we communicate to MedSecure:
- Send the redacted SOC2 + SIG exports within 3 business days (I will attach).
- Schedule the tech sync with Priyom to align on peering details this week.
- LegalOps to share DPA + SCCs and a DocuSign route for signature.

—Neha Kapoor
Director, Compliance & Legal
Redwood Inference
(attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf (pdf), signed-sccs-template.docx (docx))
